intro: Smart, subtle, and modular—our Upmods Trove bed features built-in storage compartments and a clean design that blends flexibility, function, and beauty for modern living.

features.title: Comfortable cushioned design
features.text: The Trove bed is designed with comfort at its core, featuring upholstered panels on the headboard that provide soft, cushioned support for your back—perfect for reading, lounging, or watching TV in bed.

features.title: Integrated storage that saves space
features.text: The sliding headboard panels add elegance while concealing generous storage compartments beneath, thoughtfully designed for quick and easy access to everyday essentials.

features.title: LED light for added convenience
features.text: Motion sensing LED Light on either ends of the headboard illuminates when the sliding headboard panel is opened, adding convenience to your daily routine.

features.title: Majestic, modular design
features.text: The bold, elegant structure makes a statement, while the modular system lets you upgrade just the headboard whenever you wish.

features.title: Eco-hydraulic base
features.text: The eco lift-up base gives you under-bed storage with a smoother, more energy-efficient mechanism for daily ease.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Upmods Trove King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Upholstered Led Headboard And Eco Lift Up Hydraulic Storage
